_doc: GHI #647 cutover snapshot (shrink-only; never add to silence a fresh violation). The remaining entries are NOT hollow proofs and are NOT unverifiable. REQ-0.0.59-01-06 / 01-07 prove 'GHI #165 / #531 closed superseded against ADR-0.0.59'; the closure is real and externally verifiable (`gh issue view <n> --json state` returns CLOSED — the REQ's own stated witness). They are grandfathered because their proof shape is a GitHub-issue-state check, which is NEITHER of the SUPPORT channel's two mechanisms (a ledger event + a `gz validate` structural scope) — a channel/taxonomy mismatch: these REQs were tagged [SUPPORT] but their witness is an external-outcome check the offline closeout_proof gate does not run. Accepted as a documented limitation (operator decision, 2026-06-26). Draining them would require re-tagging the two REQs to a ledger-verifiable proof (their genuine subject is the GHI closure, for which no ledger event exists) or adding an external-outcome proof channel.
